2607.26947.title: Progressive Multimodal Alignment for Continual Instruction Tuning
2607.26947.paper_summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on a projector to align visual representations with the language embedding space, making it central to cross-modal understanding. In Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT), however, shifting visual distributions and evolving instruction semantics cause this shared projector to drift, leading to projector-level forgetting, an issue largely overlooked by methods that focus primarily on the LLM backbone. We introduce Progressive Multimodal Alignment (PMA), a framework that enables the projector to adapt continually while preserving previously learned alignment. PMA detects multimodal distribution shifts via a lightweight representation descriptor and progressively expands projector experts only when needed. An expandable router integrates expert outputs based on multimodal features, while the original pretrained projector is retained as a stable alignment anchor. This progressive mechanism balances stability and plasticity with sub-linear parameter growth and serves as a method-agnostic add-on to existing MCIT approaches. Extensive experiments on two recent MCIT benchmarks demonstrate that mitigating projector-level forgetting yields consistent gains over prior state-of-the-art methods when combined with PMA. Moreover, PMA scales across diverse MLLM backbones, demonstrating robust and broadly applicable MCIT performance.
2607.26947.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）依賴於一個投影器來將視覺表徵與語言嵌入空間對齊，使其在跨模態理解中變得至關重要。然而，在多模態持續指令調整（MCIT）中，視覺分佈的變化和指令語義的演變導致這個共享投影器偏移，造成投影器層級的遺忘，這是主要集中於LLM主幹的方法所忽視的問題。我們引入了漸進式多模態對齊（PMA），這是一個使投影器能夠持續適應的框架，同時保留先前學習的對齊。PMA通過輕量級的表徵描述符檢測多模態分佈的變化，並僅在需要時逐步擴展投影器專家。一個可擴展的路由器根據多模態特徵整合專家輸出，而原始的預訓練投影器則保留作為穩定的對齊錨點。這種漸進式機制在參數增長上保持亞線性，平衡了穩定性和可塑性，並作為一種方法無關的附加組件應用於現有的MCIT方法。在兩個最近的MCIT基準上進行的廣泛實驗表明，減輕投影器層級的遺忘在與PMA結合時，能夠持續獲得相較於先前最先進方法的一致增益。此外，PMA在多樣的MLLM主幹上具有良好的擴展性，展現出穩健且廣泛適用的MCIT性能。
